_comment: Maximum line width, in em, for terms matching each regex (first match wins). Visual-order Arabic must be wrapped at build time: when TMP wraps it, the logical first word of each line drops to the next one. Within a wrapped line words are joined with no-break spaces so TMP cannot break it again. King-card description box: lines up to 11.49 em fit, 11.84 em and up were re-wrapped (in-game screenshots, 2026-09-26); 11.0 leaves a margin. Everything else falls back to 20 em.
